searchText: Hi, I'm from Sunnyside Labs testing PeerDAS with <@288990561279541248>. I'm not sure whether this has been already discussed, but found an issue on a prysm-nethermind supernode instance. The instance couldn't follow the chain after giving following errors. Prysm returns errors for all sidecars (128 times for each index), e.g. `[2025-04-22 10:59:27.94] ERROR sync: Sidecar index out of range - should never happen index=20` I think this happens because it fails to reconstruct data column sidecars from the received block, but am not sure whether this error can be ignored. After a while, a reorg happened and block height no longer increased. Could Prysm team have a look? excerpts.content: Hi, I'm from Sunnyside Labs testing PeerDAS with <@288990561279541248>. I'm not sure whether this has been already discussed, but found an issue on a prysm-nethermind supernode instance.

excerpts.author: sunnysidedj_42398
excerpts.content:
The instance couldn't follow the chain after giving following errors.
Prysm returns errors for all sidecars (128 times for each index), e.g.
`[2025-04-22 10:59:27.94] ERROR sync: Sidecar index out of range - should never happen index=20`
I think this happens because it fails to reconstruct data column sidecars from the received block, but am not sure whether this error can be ignored.
After a while, a reorg happened and block height no longer increased.

Could Prysm team have a look?
